all per-case PASS records are needed for aggregate pass
receipts never imply formal proof, synthesis/PPA, FPGA observation, physical energy or SOTA
tool_versions: Provided by root flake.lock through devShells.hdl, subject to platform and lock file
status: source and harness prepared, not run; Rust/Verilator/Nix toolchain unavailable on authoring host
claim_ceiling: Even a passing software-oracle RTL sweep establishes only word-level functional equivalence under the pinned simulation setup; no formal proof, PPA, FPGA, ASIC, measured energy or product/SOTA claim.
receipt_fields: hashes for RTL modules/testbenches, generator, canonical BinaryHV source, package manifest, Cargo.lock, runner, manifest, schema, case matrix, validator, flake.nix and flake.lock
generated canonical-oracle receipt SHA and fixture hashes for each datapath width
exact Git HEAD and Verilator version
per-case ID, module, architecture, width, lint/build/simulation exit codes, local PASS and software-oracle PASS flags
validation_protocol: generate fixtures with cargo run --locked --offline against exact Git HEAD
verify canonical source, Cargo.lock, generator metadata and generated .mem hashes
run every XOR/linear/tree architecture at all four widths with the matching generated oracle .mem file
validate the receipt schema and run validate_hdl_receipt.sh
reject any missing, duplicate, failing, stale-source or mismatched-hash case
